reviewer: Independent assistant manual review of every actual input and raw output. Developer-authored synthetic development screen; no new holdout inspected. Reviewer also implemented prompt-contract helpers, so this is not a blinded independent human study.
scope: Raw complete model responses before Core validation/fallback. This review does not establish Windows or whole-app SLA compliance.
contract_review: Exact fixed trained raw completion contract, explicit BOS/no-BOS via token IDs, no general prompt/JSON/mask. No prompt-contract bug identified in these outputs.

definitions.faithful: Retains intended facts, speech act, uncertainty, tone, quoted wording and exact protected dictionary literals. Harmless quote punctuation is assessed separately from lexical/semantic harm.
definitions.edit_needed: Human judgment that Core-normalized baseline needs cleanup; excludes benign alternative wording and already normalized numbers.
definitions.useful: Faithful output makes a beneficial edit to the cleanup problem; cosmetic punctuation alone does not count when the required correction remains. Partial useful filler/correction edits can count; see cleanup_complete.
definitions.cleanup_complete: Meets intended cleanup at adequate fidelity; preserves no-edit text acceptably. Minor punctuation alternatives do not fail this judgment.
definitions.acceptable: Faithful, fully cleaned where needed, and readable plain text; unsolicited malformed punctuation is tracked separately from semantic fidelity.
